baseline: meta/main ARM64 CPython 3.14 adaptive-aware AUTOJIT=50 Lib/test module probe
notes: The original run classified test.test_regrtest as no_tests despite return code 2. An isolated adaptive-aware AUTOJIT=50 rerun passed, so it is tracked as a probe anomaly rather than a confirmed failure.
resource_denied and no_tests entries are tracked as non-run coverage gaps, not adaptive-aware regressions.

failure_groups.cause: Recursive call paths fail or crash after compile_after_n_calls(50) installs the AutoJIT entrypoint. The strongest reproducer is a recursive keyword call that reaches JITRT_CallWithKeywordArgs before CPython raises RecursionError.
Event ordering, line reporting, opcode tracing, and frame visibility differ once functions can cross from interpreted/adaptive execution into CinderX JIT.
Generator frame locals and yield-from behavior diverge under delayed AutoJIT.
Signal/KeyboardInterrupt behavior fails and test_threading timed out under compile_after_n_calls(50).
ENV CHANGED result, likely related to the existing jit-all generator/finalizer cleanup debt.

Passes under frame-eval-nojit but fails when CinderX JIT is enabled, even at compile_after_n_calls(1000000) with no recorded compiled functions. Stable failures are Test_Pep523API.test_inlined_binary_subscr, where CPython's PEP 523 eval-frame recorder sees 0 calls instead of 200, and CAPITest.test_is_unique_temporary, where the CPython 3.14 LOAD_FAST_BORROW refcount expectation sees 2 instead of 1.

Passes under frame-eval-nojit but fails when CinderX JIT is enabled, even at compile_after_n_calls(1000000) with no recorded compiled functions. test_loop_quicken expects CALL_PY_GENERAL in adaptive disassembly but observes CALL.
